title: Home
text:
Welcome to my portfolio for MUSA 5080: Public Policy Analytics at the University of Pennsylvania.
This site documents my work in the Master of Urban Spatial Analytics program — weekly notes, course assignments, and a final project applying data analysis to urban policy questions.

title: Home
text:
About Me
Hello! My name is Michael and I’m a student in the Master of Urban Spatial Analytics Program at the University of Pennsylvania.
I’m passionate about turning complex urban data into intuitive, decision-ready tools that make a tangible impact on how cities are understood and managed.

title: About Me
text:
I graduated from Vassar College with a BA in International Studies and recently completed a graduate certificate in GIS at The George Washington University.
I began the MUSA program at the University of Pennsylvania to combine my GIS experience with data science tools, including predictive modeling, model evaluation, and statistics, alongside coding languages like Python and JavaScript. With these tools, I look forward to building end-to-end systems that address pressing urban challenges.

title: Week 2: Getting started with R
text:
Quarto is a publishing system that mixes writing and code in one document.

You write in Markdown.
You embed R code in chunks.
Quarto runs the code and weaves the output.





Quarto helps us write HTML website without writing HTML code!
As a result, you don’t have as much control over your website.
